info.title: ePharmacy - Online Pharmacy Management System API
info.description: OpenAPI 3.0 specification for ePharmacy Single-Pharmacy E-Commerce & Management System (RUET CSE 3206)

get.description: Returns a paginated list of available medicines with pricing, category, and stock availability.

200.description: A JSON array of medicine items

post.description: Adds specified quantity of a medicine to the active session/user cart.
Uploads patient prescription image or PDF for pharmacist verification prior to fulfillment.

201.description: Prescription uploaded successfully with status PENDING

post.description: Executes order creation, locks stock atomically, and registers payment strategy.
